board_drafts.subject: Update on your Bulldog tee request
board_drafts.body:
Hi Tauhid,

Thanks for reaching out about a Bulldog tee in size S. We don’t have size S available right now, so we can’t fill your request from current stock. We’re seeking approval to release the already-described Rush reprint; we are not placing a duplicate order. The vendor’s lead time is 5 days after payment and order release. We can’t give an exact arrival date because approval and release timing are not yet known.

We do have other sizes in stock, but we won’t substitute one without your agreement. Please let us know if you’d like to consider another size.

Best,
Campus Customs
